controls.name: real_engine_cancel
controls.positive_reader_refusal: receipt is not an accepted routing result
controls.interpretation: Actual deliberate cancellation requested SIGINT and the existing runner reported cleanup complete. The recorded engine exit is -9; this is not evidence that the engine terminated from SIGINT alone.

positive_preservation: The actual positive receipt retains SHA1024f98a and original absolute paths. Source bytes match its packet pins. The completed frozen controller records initial full-current replay and requires final full positive route/export replay before publication; this review does not rerun those readers.

costs.accounting: One actual control execution under the frozen protocol, including reaped children and publication. External whole costs satisfy the 260-second wall/fullCPU gate; inner costs are nested subsets. Preparation, prior positive run and review costs are separate.

limits: These are actual failure-control and safe-delivery prerequisites on the exposed owned fixture. No new positive reroute, routing gain, unrelated-family breadth, actual GUI, human/electrical approval, zero-warning whole-project cleanliness or release-readiness claim follows.
